<!-- All news items below this line -->{{Current events|year=2004|month=01|day=19|content=

* Cargo ship [[MS Rocknes|MS ''Rocknes'']] with a crew of 30 including the pilot capsizes near [[Bergen]], Norway at 1630 local time (1530 [[UTC]]). Two people are reported dead and 24 still missing the morning after the accident. The ship was carrying a heavy load of rocks for use as shielding on top of a gas pipeline to [[Emden]], Germany, from the Norwegian [[Ormen Lange (gas field)|Ormen Lange]] offshore gas field.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/europe/3412079.stm|title=BBC NEWS - Europe - Hunt for fjord survivors is over|publisher=|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref>
* The English Court of Appeal calls for an end to the prosecution of parents whose babies may have died of [[Sudden Infant Death Syndrome]] (cot death) in cases where the only evidence is contended expert testimony.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/england/wiltshire/3409183.stm|title=BBC NEWS - UK - England - Wiltshire - Baby death trials to be reviewed|publisher=|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref>
* The [[European Space Agency]] releases detailed colour images of the surface of [[Mars]], taken by its orbiting [[Mars Express]] probe.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.esa.int/export/SPECIALS/Mars_Express/SEMWF0474OD_0.html|title=First spectacular results from Mars Express|author=esa|work=European Space Agency|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref>
* [[NASA]]'s [[Mars Exploration Rover Mission|Spirit rover]] arrives at its initial destination, a rock named "''[[Adirondack (Mars)|Adirondack]]''", and prepares for analysis.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://story.news.yahoo.com/news?tmpl=story&cid=96&e=1&u=/space/20040120/sc_space/spiritpreparestounlockadirondack|title=Yahoo News - Latest News & Headlines|work=Yahoo News|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://dsc.discovery.com/news/briefs/20040119/spirit.html |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050306001551/http://dsc.discovery.com/news/briefs/20040119/spirit.html |archive-date=2005-03-06 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* [[U.S. presidential election, 2004]]: The [[Iowa caucuses]] yield unexpectedly strong results for [[United States Democratic Party|Democratic]] candidates [[John Kerry]], who earns 38% of the state's delegates and [[John Edwards]], who takes 32%. Former front-runner [[Howard Dean]] slips to 18%, and [[Dick Gephardt|Richard A. "Dick" Gephardt]]'s fourth-place (11%) finish<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/articles/A30424-2004Jan19.html |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-12-20 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121026052223/http://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/articles/A30424-2004Jan19.html |archive-date=2012-10-26 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://pennlive.com/newsflash/lateststories/index.ssf?/base/politics-1/107456304117782.xml|title=Nation & World|accessdate=22 December 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141015214858/http://www.pennlive.com/newsflash/lateststories/index.ssf?%2Fbase%2Fpolitics-1%2F107456304117782.xml|archive-date=15 October 2014|url-status=dead}}</ref> prompts him to end his presidential bid.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://abcnews.go.com/wire/Politics/ap20040119_1786.html |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20040804161333/http://abcnews.go.com/wire/Politics/ap20040119_1786.html |archive-date=2004-08-04 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* [[Yigal Amir]], assassin of [[Yitzhak Rabin]], plans to marry.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.blogitorial.com/2004/01/yigal_amir_to_marry.html|title=Welcome to BLOGITORIAL.COM|accessdate=22 December 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151211072313/http://www.blogitorial.com/2004/01/yigal_amir_to_marry.html|archive-date=11 December 2015|url-status=dead}}</ref>
* "[[Snow White and The Madness of Truth]]" displayed at a [[Stockholm]] museum is again vandalized. A Russian-Jewish artist floats another image in the pool, that of [[Mijailo Mijailovic]], the murderer of Swedish foreign minister [[Anna Lindh]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.israelnn.com/news.php3?id=56425|title=Israel News - Israel's #1 News Site - Arutz Sheva|work=Arutz Sheva|accessdate=22 December 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20051223222228/http://www.israelnn.com/news.php3?id=56425|archive-date=23 December 2005|url-status=dead}}</ref>
* [[José María Aznar]]'s government in Spain is dissolved prior to March general elections. He has said he will not run for a third term of office.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.guardian.co.uk/spain/article/0,2763,1126831,00.html|title=Aznar hangs up his legislative boots|author=Giles Tremlett|work=the Guardian|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref>
